# Statvix

> > Statvix is a SaaS security compliance and data analytics hub helping founders and teams navigate SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and emerging regulations like the EU AI Act and NIS2 Directive.

Statvix provides comprehensive guides, compliance frameworks, and tool comparisons for SaaS companies seeking to build security-first cultures and achieve enterprise-grade certifications. The platform covers both foundational standards and cutting-edge compliance trends for 2026, including data sovereignty, passkey authentication, and autonomous audit automation.

## Key Topics

- SOC 2
- ISO 27001
- GDPR
- HIPAA
- PCI DSS 4.0
- EU AI Act
- NIS2 Directive
- Data Sovereignty
- Compliance Automation
- SaaS Security
- Passkeys
- Risk Analytics
- Vanta
- Drata
- Cyber Essentials

## Compliance Frameworks & Standards

- [How Much Does an ISO 27001 Certification Actually Cost in 2026?](https://statvix.com/how-much-does-an-iso-27001-certification-actually-cost-in-2026): Breakdown of ISO 27001 certification costs, audit fees, and implementation expenses
- [Remote-First SOC 2: Managing Access Control and Asset Tracking Globally](https://statvix.com/remote-first-soc-2-managing-access-control-and-asset-tracking-globally): Guide for SOC 2 compliance in remote-first organizations with global asset tracking
- [ISO 22301: Ensuring SaaS Resilience During Global Infrastructure Outages](https://statvix.com/iso-22301-ensuring-saas-resilience-during-global-infrastructure-outages): Guide on ISO 22301 business continuity and SaaS resilience during outages
- [Beyond SOC 2: Why UK-Bound SaaS Startups Need Cyber Essentials](https://statvix.com/beyond-soc-2-why-uk-bound-saas-startups-need-cyber-essentials): Comparison of SOC 2 and Cyber Essentials for UK-based SaaS startups
- [PCI DSS 4.0: Mastering the Transition for SaaS Payment Platforms](https://statvix.com/pci-dss-4-0-mastering-the-transition-for-saas-payment-platforms): Transition guide for PCI DSS 4.0 compliance and SaaS payment platform security

## Regulatory & Emerging Compliance Trends

- [The EU AI Act Roadmap: Essential Compliance Steps for SaaS Founders](https://statvix.com/the-eu-ai-act-roadmap-essential-compliance-steps-for-saas-founders): Compliance roadmap for EU AI Act covering risk classification and legal requirements
- [NIS2 Directive for SaaS: Is Your Infrastructure Compliant for 2026?](https://statvix.com/nis2-directive-for-saas-is-your-infrastructure-compliant-for-2026): Compliance guide for NIS2 Directive covering SaaS infrastructure and EU security
- [Data Sovereignty in 2026: Analyzing Global Residency Challenges for Cloud SaaS](https://statvix.com/data-sovereignty-in-2026-analyzing-global-residency-challenges-for-cloud-saas): Analysis of data sovereignty, residency, and GDPR compliance for cloud SaaS
- [The Rise of Sovereign Clouds: Navigating Data Sovereignty for SaaS in 2026](https://statvix.com/the-rise-of-sovereign-clouds-navigating-data-sovereignty-for-saas-in-2026): Analysis of sovereign clouds, data sovereignty, and GDPR/CCPA compliance trends
- [The End of Passwords: How Passkeys are Changing SaaS Compliance in 2026](https://statvix.com/the-end-of-passwords-how-passkeys-are-changing-saas-compliance-in-2026): Analysis of passkeys, authentication, and 2026 SaaS compliance trends with GDPR
- [Data Minimization Analytics: Reducing Your Compliance Footprint in 2026](https://statvix.com/data-minimization-analytics-reducing-your-compliance-footprint-in-2026): Guide on data minimization strategy and GDPR/CCPA compliance footprint reduction
